settings.heading: Terms of Service
settings.body:

We may correct errors, update listings, change pricing, cancel orders, refuse orders, limit quantities, or issue refunds when information is inaccurate, incomplete, unavailable, restricted, or suspected of fraud.

Products must be used only as intended and according to any instructions, warnings, manuals, labels, compatibility notes, age guidance, or manufacturer guidance. We are not responsible for misuse, improper installation, unauthorized modification, unsafe use, or failure to follow instructions.

By placing an order, you confirm your billing, shipping, contact, and payment information is accurate and complete, you are authorized to use the payment method, you are old enough to purchase under applicable law, and the order is for lawful use.

Shipping is governed by our Shipping Policy. Returns and refunds are governed by our No Returns and Refund Policy. We do not accept buyer-remorse returns or exchanges at launch. Do not send products back to the sender, supplier, package address, carrier address, or any address found online.

Damaged, defective, wrong, missing, unshipped, or materially inaccurate orders should be reported through Shopify Inbox so we can review the issue and offer an appropriate resolution where required or approved.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, exemplary, or punitive damages, including lost profits, lost data, delivery delays, business interruption, product misuse, or third-party service issues.

Questions about these Terms should be sent through Shopify Inbox using the chat or contact option shown on the store.
